data.title: Greenridge
data.about:
Greenridge is an upcoming townhouse community by Emaar Properties. The project offers 3 and 4-bedroom elegant townhouse offering ample space and comfort. The interiors of Greenridge luxury townhouses Dubai are thoughtfully designed with earthy tones and spacious living areas, creating a harmonious and comfortable atmosphere for family living.

These family homes provide residents with an array of facilities ranging from an outdoor fitness area to a community center. Greenridge is located in Emaar South, a prime location just minutes away from Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City. Proximity to a world-class 18-hole championship golf course makes Greenridge a perfect residence for golf enthusiasts who want to live near the greens.

characteristics_module.title: A Tranquil Oasis Designed for Families
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Meticulously designed 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses with two types of facades to choose from.
  • Spacious homes with floor-to-ceiling windows provide residents with breathtaking golf course views.
  • The community is surrounded by scenic green spaces and parks, providing a peaceful and natural environment for residents to enjoy.
  • Perfect for family living, the Greenridge Project by Emaar Properties offers both privacy and a vibrant community vibe.
  • Enjoy excellent connectivity with easy access to Dubai's key attractions.
  • The easy installment plan of Greenridge in Emaar South starts with just a 10 percent down payment.

location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Emaar South is a thriving, master-planned community nestled in Dubai’s dynamic landscape, offering a perfect blend of modern living and innovation.

The community is home to top-tier schools, dining destinations, and retail centers, ensuring convenience and comfort at every corner. Strategically located, Emaar South is not only a place to live but a hub for growth, opportunity, and modern living.
